windowsPlatformRuntimeGate.criteria: local executable launch, settings save, and installer dry-run launch

blenderHostRuntimeGate.reason: Blender 5.1.1 CLI smoke, add-on import, user manual install, registry validation, sync preview, Preview Reload, Reload Safe Links, and saved source viewport update passed.

manualFixturePackage.criteria: integration .blend, part .blend files, registry, and manual test docs are packaged for testers

guiRegistryEditing.criteria: scan and file-selector registry candidates default to safe local values, save through registry validation, and explicit Link operation does not auto-save .blend

linkCandidateSelection.criteria: Link Candidate inspects available collection/object names, prefers production targets, and does not fall back to first ref collection when requested collection is missing

collectionCheckboxMultiLink.criteria: Loaded .blend collections are shown as checkbox choices and checked collections can be previewed and linked as multiple scene-tree collections

indirectLinkedLibraryReport.criteria: Source .blend nested Blender Links are previewed as sourceLinkedLibraries and reported after execute as indirectLinkedLibraries without localizing or auto-saving dependencies

linkTargetTypeExpansion.criteria: Reference image, light, and camera objects are reported as explicit typed candidates, floor/helper objects are excluded with reasons, and non-model objects are not selected implicitly

japaneseUiLocalization.criteria: ja_JP translation table covers core panel, operator, button, property, and report strings; Blender 5.1.1 pgettext_iface resolves core labels in Japanese

linkIntegration.criteria: Preview Integrate reports target linked datablocks without mutation; Integrate Link requires confirmation, makes selected linked datablocks local, writes a report, and does not auto-save .blend

characterBlendRelationship.criteria: Character.blend, base body, head/face, hair, clothes, and accessories roles, reference directions, registry rows, and validation report responsibilities are separated for user-facing workflow guidance

releasePublication.criteria: v0.1.0 formal release, release assets, TODO/Issues closure, and post-release verification evidence are synchronized
